site_id.label: Site Label
site_id.helper: Plot or village identifier from your field log.

device_id.label: Sensor Unit
device_id.helper: Hardware label carried through to fault tickets and exports.

nitrogen_mg_kg.label: Available Nitrogen (N)
nitrogen_mg_kg.helper: Mineral N in mg/kg dry soil. Keep distinct from Kjeldahl Total N (%).

phosphorus_mg_kg.label: Phosphorus (P)
phosphorus_mg_kg.helper: Available P in mg/kg dry soil.

potassium.label: Potassium (K)
potassium.helper: SRDI lab reports in cmol(+)/kg convert automatically by multiplying by 391.

ph.label: Soil pH
ph.helper: Valid soil probe range spans pH 3.0 to 10.0.

ec.label: Electrical Conductivity (EC)
ec.helper: Select the exact unit on your firmware readout (1 dS/m equals 1000 uS/cm).

salinity_mg_l.label: Salinity (Optional Check)
salinity_mg_l.helper: Used to cross-check EC register scaling (~0.5 to 0.7 times EC in uS/cm).

temperature_c.label: Soil Temperature
temperature_c.helper: Used in the standardized z_T * z_M interaction term.

moisture_pct.label: Soil Moisture / Humidity
moisture_pct.helper: Readings at or above 98% flag water saturation interference on bulk EC.

depth_cm.label: Sampling Depth
depth_cm.helper: Depth horizon used to select matching calibration bounds.

texture_class.label: Soil Texture
texture_class.helper: Surface area and clay fraction affect organic matter stabilization.

van_bemmelen_k.label: Van Bemmelen Factor (k)
van_bemmelen_k.helper: Default is 1.724. Adjust only when local lab combustion pairs measure a different factor.

days_since_rain.label: Days Since Heavy Rain
days_since_rain.helper: Values under 3 days help explain sudden EC spikes.

days_since_fertilizer.label: Days Since Fertilizer
days_since_fertilizer.helper: Values under 3 days trigger transient ion caution.

validation_inline.required_number: Enter a numeric value before running calibration.
validation_inline.non_finite: Value must be a finite number (NaN and Infinity are blocked).
validation_inline.negative_forbidden: This soil measurement cannot be negative.
validation_inline.ph_out_of_bounds: Soil pH must sit between 3.0 and 10.0 to pass sensor physics checks.
validation_inline.temp_out_of_bounds: Soil temperature must sit between -10 deg C and 60 deg C.
validation_inline.ec_unit_required: Choose dS/m or uS/cm before computing EC interactions.
validation_inline.ec_salinity_mismatch: Salinity disagrees with EC by more than 2x. Check whether firmware swapped the registers.

trust_gauge.disclosure: Calibrated estimate from sensor inputs and site covariates. Display alongside its 95% interval and model tag.
trust_gauge.barc_disclaimer: Reference scale from Bangladesh BARC/SRDI fertility guidelines for field context.
trust_gauge.empty_prompt: Enter field readings on the left or tap a preset above to run a local calibration check.

hardware_fault.title: Hardware Sensor Fault (Prediction Blocked)
hardware_fault.summary_template: {device_id} at {site_id} reported {fault_metric}. SOM estimation is paused until hardware readings fall inside physical soil limits.
steps: 1. Unplug and reseat the RS485 probe connector, then wipe mud and salt film off the electrode tip.
2. Place the pH probe in 7.00 and 4.01 calibration buffers to confirm electrode voltage responds.
3. Inspect Modbus register scaling for decimal shifts (a raw reading of 0.12 can reflect a disconnected probe or a x10/x100 register mismatch).

saturation_disturbance.title: Water Saturation Caution (Moisture >= 98%)
saturation_disturbance.summary: Standing water fills soil pores and raises bulk electrical conductivity independently of organic matter. Treat the EC * Moisture contribution as disturbed.
saturation_disturbance.action: Log this reading with a wet-field tag. Wait 48 hours after drainage before comparing week-over-week SOM trends.

transient_ion_disturbance.title: Transient Ion Spike Flagged
transient_ion_disturbance.summary: High EC (> 2.0 dS/m) combined with high moisture or recent rain/fertilizer (< 3 days) inflates apparent conductivity.
transient_ion_disturbance.action: Retest after irrigation water settles or soluble fertilizer salts diffuse.

temporal_jump.title: Rapid 24-Hour Shift (> 0.35% SOM)
temporal_jump.summary: Real soil organic matter changes slowly across seasons. A jump above 0.35 percentage points within 24 hours points to probe drift, wetting, or fertilizer application.
temporal_jump.action: Verify electrode seating and record soil moisture before saving this point to a plot log.

ood_rejected.title: Outside Calibration Range (Estimate Withheld)
ood_rejected.summary: One or more inputs fall outside the calibrated training bounds or exceed the Mahalanobis D^2 99th percentile threshold. SOMSense withholds numeric extrapolation here.
ood_rejected.action: Collect a paired soil core from this plot and upload the lab result in Calibrate Lab Data to extend the local domain.

equations.title: Model Equations and Standardization
equations.subtitle: Inspect the 9-term standardized linear equation and Van Bemmelen conversion
equations.note: Training fold means (mu_j) and standard deviations (s_j) standardize each term before computing z_T * z_M and z_EC * z_M.

shap_drivers.title: Feature Drivers (SHAP and Coefficients)
shap_drivers.subtitle: See how each input nudged Estimated SOM (%) away from the training baseline
shap_drivers.blocked_note: Driver bars pause when a hardware fault or out-of-range reading blocks estimation.

raw_telemetry.security_note: Prototype-pollution keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype) and spreadsheet formula prefixes (=, +, -, @) are stripped locally.

tab_calibrate_lab.heading: Paired Field and Lab Calibration Studio
tab_calibrate_lab.intro: Upload paired sensor and laboratory rows for your AEZ plot to inspect unit conversions, leakage guardrails, and local Ridge recalibration.
tab_calibrate_lab.upload_dropzone_label: Choose or drop paired calibration CSV
tab_calibrate_lab.upload_limits_note: Browser parser accepts files up to 5 MB and 10,000 rows. Data stays on your device.
unit_rules: Exchangeable K in cmol(+)/kg multiplies by 391.0 to yield mg/kg.
EC in uS/cm divides by 1000.0 to yield dS/m.
USDA-style SOC in g/kg divides by 10.0 to yield %SOC.
tab_calibrate_lab.leak_guardrail_body: Any TN_pct column is excluded from SOM predictors. On the SRDI Kushtia benchmark, TN_pct was computed from OM_pct (r = 0.978), which creates false near-perfect accuracy.
tab_calibrate_lab.cn_warning_body: Independent Total N paired with SOC yielded C:N outside 5 to 35. Verify whether N is recorded in % or mg/kg, or tag organic soil horizons.
tab_calibrate_lab.status_complete_template: Local Ridge calibration updated across {n_sites} sites.
tab_calibrate_lab.empty_state: Download the AEZ CSV template or upload at least 15 paired rows across multiple plots to run local calibration.

tab_science_poxc.heading: Scientific Basis and POXC Active Carbon
tab_science_poxc.fizar_pathway_body: Soil probes read electrical conductivity, moisture, temperature, pH, and NPK proxies. SOMSense translates those raw signals into calibrated %SOC and %SOM with conformal uncertainty bounds.
tab_science_poxc.mineral_only_proof_body: Across 873 cleaned Kaggle mineral rows containing only N, P, K, pH, and EC, cross-validated Ridge R^2 drops below zero (-0.078). Soil temperature, moisture, and local site metadata are essential for calibration.
tab_science_poxc.poxc_section_body: Permanganate Oxidizable Carbon (POXC) tracks labile organic matter sensitive to tillage and residue management. SOMSense reports POXC strictly in mg C/kg dry soil using a separate USDA KSSL-grounded model.

poxc_estimator.heading: POXC Quick Estimator
poxc_estimator.ratio_note: Arable mineral soil POXC to SOC ratios normally sit between 0.02 and 0.06.

tab_science_poxc.passive_c_guardrail_body: Total SOC minus POXC blends mineral-associated and particulate pools of different turnover rates. Report POXC and Total SOC side by side without subtracting them to estimate passive carbon.
tab_science_poxc.datasets_heading: Verified Benchmark Datasets and Audit Fixes

dataset_cards.name: SRDI Kushtia Benchmark (171 rows, 57 GPS grid points)
dataset_cards.detail: Three depths (0-20, 20-40, 40-60 cm) grouped by Sample_ID. Converted K from cmol(+)/kg to mg/kg (x391) and excluded circular TN_pct.

dataset_cards.name: Kaggle Soil Fertility (880 raw rows, 873 cleaned)
dataset_cards.detail: Removed 7 extreme rows (pH 0.90 to 11.15 and OC 24.0%) via physics filters to demonstrate mineral-only generalization limits.

dataset_cards.name: USDA-NRCS KSSL POX-C (42 samples, 38 pedons)
dataset_cards.detail: Filtered to <2 mm sieve and 2.5 g assay trials. Fixed the data dictionary unit bug by dividing g/kg SOC values by 10.

error_states.csv_parse_failed: Could not read that CSV file. Check that headers match the AEZ template and numbers contain no stray units.
error_states.file_too_large: File exceeds the 5 MB browser limit. Split your log into smaller batches and retry.
error_states.row_limit_exceeded: CSV exceeds 10,000 rows. Trim old calibration logs before importing.
error_states.registry_checksum_failed: Model artifact SHA-256 verification failed. Local calculations are paused until a verified registry.json loads.
error_states.json_malformed: Clipboard text is not valid JSON. Check brackets and quotes around field names.
